verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical, and both have the same serious problems. The photo is cropped so tightly that only a chin and mouth show (no eyes, no full face). The 'HOW IT WORKS?' headline sits on top of the smiling face, so the text is on a busy image. The bulb, arrow, question-mark and atom doodles are piled onto the cheek as a cluttered fragment. The 'PODCAST WITH HARRY LEE HOFFMAN' subtitle is wrapped into a cramped four-line column with an awkward 'WITH' line. B moves the headline and doodles a few pixels, which doesn't fix any of these flaws.
